counter_mechanics.desc: 60% healing reduction shuts down drain tanks
Stack armor vs full AD comps
Stack MR vs full AP comps
% HP true damage ignores all resistances
Kite melee champions who can't close gap
Hard engage forces fights before poke matters
Heal back poke damage over time
Avoid 5v5 by forcing side lane pressure

universal_counters.why: W reflects AA damage. Thornmail passive. Taunt forces AAs.
E reduces AS by 50%. R engage. Armor scaling.
W Silver Bolts %HP true damage every 3 AAs.
Vital procs %HP true damage. W parries any CC.
E Black Shield blocks ALL CC on one target.
W Steadfast Presence blocks ALL dashes in zone.
W Polymorph disables assassin for 1.5s. R knockup saves carry.
R Ragnarok = CC immune. Run at carries freely.
Passive reduces magic damage by 15%. Q interrupts channels.
R Monsoon pushes ALL divers away + heals team.
R Undying Rage = can't die for 5s. Ignores burst.
Passive fears champions who dash near her. Anti-mobility mage.
MR shield passive. W taunt interrupts combos. R protects allies.
Passive blocks CC. R massive HP regen. Unkillable.
R Spirit Refuge teleports to any ally. Global counter-split.

lane_matchups.why: Vayne kites with Q tumble. W true damage shreds. Darius can't reach.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Run Ghost. Flash+E pull. All-in at level 1 before she scales.

lane_matchups.why: Quinn E knockback denies Darius pull. Range poke. Blind AAs.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Survive to 6. Flash+E engage. She's squishy if caught.

lane_matchups.why: Teemo blind negates Garen E. Range poke. Shroom control.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Q removes slow. Run through shrooms. All-in with R execute.

lane_matchups.why: Malphite armor stacking reduces Fiora damage. Safe and unkillable.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W parry his R. Vital procs still do %HP true damage.

lane_matchups.why: Malphite E reduces Jax AS. Armor stacking. Jax can't trade.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm to 3 items. Outscale. BotRK %HP helps.

lane_matchups.why: Jax E dodges Camille AA-reliant Q2. Counter Strike wins trades.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W poke. E disengage. Don't trade during his E.

lane_matchups.why: Fiora W parries Renekton W stun. Out-duels after level 5.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Fury W through her parry timing. Bait it then engage.

lane_matchups.why: Renekton W stun breaks Irelia Q chain. Early bully wins.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm stacks. Don't fight until BotRK + Passive stacked.

lane_matchups.why: Darius bullies Nasus early. Can't stack freely. Ghost chase.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W wither Darius. Farm under tower. Outscale after 200 stacks.

lane_matchups.why: Garen silence stops Riven combos. W reduces burst. Passive heals.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Bait Q silence. E shield Garen Q. Short trade and disengage.

lane_matchups.why: Irelia can dive Kayle before level 5. Gap close ignores range.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm safe. W speed away. After level 10, outscale completely.

lane_matchups.why: Fiora parries Sett W true damage center. Out-duels with vitals.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Don't W predictably. E pull for short trades. Build armor.

lane_matchups.why: Sett can trade back with Haymaker. Sustain through K'Sante poke.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Short Q trades. W to dodge Sett W center. E away.

lane_matchups.why: Malphite armor + E AS slow. Tryndamere can't crit effectively.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Force extended trades during R. Split other lanes instead.

lane_matchups.why: Darius can pull Wukong out of W clone. Passive stacking.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W clone to dodge E pull. E+Q short trade then disengage.

lane_matchups.why: Teemo range poke. Shrooms block proxy paths. Blind AAs.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Proxy behind tower. Ignore Teemo completely. Outscale.

lane_matchups.why: Fiora vital procs ignore Ornn armor. W parries R knockup.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Play safe. Upgrade ally items. Teamfight > 1v1 her.

lane_matchups.why: Self-R during Zed R negates ALL burst. W root stops shadows.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Roam to side lanes. Avoid fighting Lissandra directly.

lane_matchups.why: Armor stacking. AS slow E. Zed can't kill.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Roam. Ignore Malphite. Kill side lanes.

lane_matchups.why: Akali shroud beats Yasuo. Can't windwall shroud. Out-bursts.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Windwall her E. Aggressive early before she has Protobelt.

lane_matchups.why: Kassadin passive reduces Ahri magic damage. Q shield. Outscales.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Win before level 13. Roam and snowball side lanes.

lane_matchups.why: Galio W taunt interrupts Katarina R. Magic shield. Out-trades.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Roam bot when Galio uses R elsewhere. Avoid direct fights.

lane_matchups.why: Lissandra R counters Fizz all-in. Self-R = invulnerable.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Wait for her R CD. Bait with E troll pole then re-engage.

lane_matchups.why: Zed shadow dives Orianna. R Death Mark pops her.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Zhonya's rush. Keep ball on yourself for R peel.

lane_matchups.why: Fizz E dodges Viktor E laser. Gap close ignores Viktor range.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W gravity field on yourself when Fizz dashes in. Stand back.

lane_matchups.why: Kassadin R dashes over Veigar E cage. Q interrupts. MR passive.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm Q stacks. Cage defensively. Outscale if game goes late enough.

lane_matchups.why: Annie point-click W stun can't be dodged by shroud position.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Shroud to dodge Tibbers R. Wait for stun CD then engage.

lane_matchups.why: Zed W+Q poke wins. R death mark kills TF.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Gold card + Zhonya's timing. Roam to bot, avoid 1v1.

lane_matchups.why: Kassadin eventually outscales. R dashes dodge Diana Q.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Win pre-6. Force trades with W shield + passive.

lane_matchups.why: Renekton W stun. Early bully. Yone can't trade back.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E spirit form poke. Disengage. Scale to 2 items.

lane_matchups.why: Fiora W parries Galio W taunt. True damage ignores MR.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Team fights > 1v1. R allies instead of dueling Fiora.

lane_matchups.why: Fizz E dodges Lux Q root. R gap close one-shots Lux.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Q root preemptively when Fizz walks up. Keep max range.

lane_matchups.why: Zed is AD. Kassadin MR passive useless. Shadow combo kills.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Survive to 6. Seekers Armguard rush. Ask jungle for help.

lane_matchups.why: Rammus W reflects Lee Sin damage. Taunt forces AA into thorns.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Don't fight Rammus. Gank other lanes. Invade early before lvl 5.

lane_matchups.why: Rammus armor. W thorns. Kha'Zix can't burst through.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Avoid Rammus. Kill isolated non-tank targets.

lane_matchups.why: Lee Sin E reveals stealth. Q to Evelynn in stealth. Early invade.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Avoid Lee Sin. Farm to 5 for stealth. Counter-gank don't invade.

lane_matchups.why: Olaf R ignores Viego W stun. Runs him down with Q spam.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Don't duel Olaf. Wait for his R to expire then fight.

lane_matchups.why: Graves E grit stacks armor. Wins early skirmishes.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm to Protobelt. Outscale in teamfights with R.

lane_matchups.why: Shyvana invades Amumu early. Outduels in 1v1.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Avoid 1v1. Group early. Your teamfight >> hers.

lane_matchups.why: Kindred marks + kiting beats Hecarim. R negates Hecarim burst.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E charge. Force fights in jungle. Don't let her kite in open.

lane_matchups.why: Rengar bush leap one-shots Graves. Can't react.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Clear wards. Track Rengar. Never facecheck bushes.

lane_matchups.why: Olaf R walks out of J4 R cataclysm. CC immune.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Don't R Olaf. Engage on his team instead. Peel for carry.

lane_matchups.why: Mundo passive blocks Sejuani CC. Out-sustains in extended fights.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Gank lanes, not Mundo. Team CC him down in teamfights.

lane_matchups.why: Morgana E Black Shield blocks Vi R lock-on stun.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Bait shield first. Or R someone else.

lane_matchups.why: Olaf R ignores Xin knockup. Lifesteal outsustains.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Don't 1v1 Olaf. Use R to block ranged damage in teamfights.

lane_matchups.why: Lee Sin early invade pressure. Sees through W clone with E.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm safely. Outscale in teamfights with double R knockup.

lane_matchups.why: Olaf R CC immune. Can't be one-shot. Runs Rengar down.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Avoid Olaf. Kill his carries instead. One-shot ADC.

lane_matchups.why: Lee Sin invades Shyvana pre-6. Stronger early. Kicks away.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Ward defensively. Give camps if he invades. Scale to dragon form.

lane_matchups.why: Rammus taunt forces Yi to AA into W thornmail. Melts himself.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Build Wit's End for MR. Or just dodge Rammus taunt with Q alpha.

lane_matchups.why: Rengar R reveals area. Can find Evelynn post-stealth.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Don't invade Rengar. Farm opposite side. Counter-gank.

lane_matchups.why: Draven wins early trades. Spinning Axes out-damage Jinx.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm with rockets from range. Don't trade. Outscale at 2 items.

lane_matchups.why: Caitlyn 650 range vs Vayne 550. Constantly poked out.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Q tumble dodges W traps. Survive to BotRK. All-in at 6.

lane_matchups.why: Draven early damage too high. Snowballs lane.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E stealth to dodge. Farm safely. R follow-up only on support CC.

lane_matchups.why: Lucian aggressive dash+passive double-shot out-trades Ezreal.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E blink away. Q poke from max range. Scale with Manamune.

lane_matchups.why: Samira W blocks Jhin W root. Dash in for melee combo.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W root before she dashes. Keep max range. Never let her build S rank.

lane_matchups.why: Draven all-in wins if he catches axes.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Q bounce poke. R from fog of war. Don't trade AA vs AA.

lane_matchups.why: Vayne condemn + kite beats Tristana in extended trades.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W jump on Vayne when condemn is CD. Burst with E bomb.

lane_matchups.why: Lucian dash+passive burst wins short trades. Aggressive.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Place feathers behind. E root if he dashes in. R to dodge burst.

lane_matchups.why: Nautilus CC feeds Samira style. But if she's CC'd she dies.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W Nautilus R knockup. E dash to reset position. Need support peel.

lane_matchups.why: Jinx outscales. Rockets out-range Lucian late game.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Win lane hard. End before Jinx gets 3 items.

lane_matchups.why: Caitlyn range zones Kai'Sa early. Trap control.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Farm to evolve Q. All-in at 6 with R past Caitlyn traps.

lane_matchups.why: Exhaust reduces Draven damage by 40%. Can't cash in.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Bait exhaust. All-in when it's on CD (210s).

lane_matchups.why: Tristana W jump + E bomb burst catches Jinx (no dash).
lane_matchups.counterplay: Chompers E under yourself when Trist W's. Rockets from max range.

lane_matchups.why: Jinx outranges with rockets. AoE damage in teamfights.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Flank in teamfights. Don't frontline vs Jinx rockets.

lane_matchups.why: MF R punishes Ezreal standing still for Q poke.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E blink sideways out of MF R. Q poke to win lane.

lane_matchups.why: Ziggs poke + tower damage denies Kai'Sa farm.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E stealth past bombs. Farm under tower. Evolve Q ASAP.

lane_matchups.why: E Black Shield blocks Nautilus hook + passive root entirely.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Wait for shield to expire (26s CD early). Engage after.

lane_matchups.why: Black Shield on ADC negates Leona all-in.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Bait shield. Or engage on Morgana herself (she's squishy).

lane_matchups.why: Braum E shield blocks Thresh hook. Stand in front of ADC.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Hook Braum. Flay ADC behind Braum. Lantern ally out.

lane_matchups.why: Lulu W polymorph when Zed R appears. R knockup saves carry.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Don't R into Lulu. Roam and kill other lanes.

lane_matchups.why: Assassins one-shot Soraka before she can heal team.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Position behind ADC. E silence zone where assassin will land.

lane_matchups.why: Nautilus all-in wins through Karma poke. CC too heavy.
lane_matchups.counterplay: W root Nautilus when he hooks. R+E speed to kite back.

lane_matchups.why: Blitz hook punishes Senna's long AA animation. One hook = death.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Stand behind minions. W mist for safety when farming souls.

lane_matchups.why: Leona all-in at 2 kills Seraphine. Too squishy.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E slow when Leona E's in. R chain stun if she overcommits.

lane_matchups.why: Thresh all-in pressure. But Milio R cleanses hook CC.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Save R for hook catch on ADC. Q poke from safe range.

lane_matchups.why: Lulu polymorph cancels Swain R drain. W blocks engage.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E root Lulu first. W poke from long range. Ignite cuts her shields.

lane_matchups.why: Ezreal E blinks Nautilus hook. Safe positioning.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Walk up for passive root instead of hooking. R point-click.

lane_matchups.why: Janna R pushes Leona away after engage. Q tornado interrupts E.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Flash R to engage past Janna. Bait tornado first.

lane_matchups.why: Sivir E spellshield blocks Thresh hook.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Flay first to pop spellshield. Then hook.

lane_matchups.why: Olaf R ignores Lulu W polymorph and R knockup.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Kite back. Shield ADC. W polymorph after Olaf R expires.

lane_matchups.why: Leona all-in kills Soraka. Can't heal through burst.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E silence on Leona E path. Stay behind ADC.

lane_matchups.why: Sona outscales Karma's poke with sustain + double auras.
lane_matchups.counterplay: Win lane before Sona scales. R+Q poke aggressively early.

lane_matchups.why: Nautilus CC chain kills Senna. She has no escape.
lane_matchups.counterplay: E mist to dodge Q hook. Position far back. W for stealth.
